description: Wakes an asleep server so players can join it from the internet at its address; not for an online server (use restartServer). While booting it fetches its mods, plugins and modpack from Modrinth, CurseForge or their download links, and a backup queued with restoreBackup replaces the current world. Starting needs enough account balance for the server's size, which pays for the running server. Returns the server; poll listServers until statusDetail is server-online, a few minutes later.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.
